scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: set -e; for f in .env sso-config.yaml; do [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" ] && [ ! -e "$f" ] && cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$f" "$f"; done; make init; grep -qE '^LANGFLOW_SECRET_KEY=.+' .env || { echo 'ERROR: LANGFLOW_SECRET_KEY is empty in .env (make qa-stack would export an empty key). Set it in the main checkout .env and re-run.'; exit 1; }

scripts.name: Dev (backend + frontend, per-worktree ports)
scripts.command: while [ -e .frontend-dev/.setup-running ]; do echo "waiting for frontend mirror setup..."; sleep 10; done; p=$((20000 + $(basename "$PWD" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 500 * 20)); echo "==> backend http://localhost:$p  frontend http://localhost:$((p+1))"; make dev BACKEND_PORT=$p VITE_PORT=$((p+1)) LANGFLOW_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:$p

scripts.name: QA stack up (per-worktree ports)
scripts.command: while [ -e .frontend-dev/.setup-running ]; do echo "waiting for frontend mirror setup..."; sleep 10; done; p=$((20000 + $(basename "$PWD" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 500 * 20)); slug=$(basename "$PWD" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -c 'a-z0-9-\n' '-'); echo "==> editor UI http://localhost:$((p+11))  editor API http://127.0.0.1:$((p+10))  control plane http://127.0.0.1:$((p+12))  serving http://127.0.0.1:$((p+13))"; make qa-stack EDITOR_BACKEND_PORT=$((p+10)) EDITOR_FRONTEND_PORT=$((p+11)) CP_PORT=$((p+12)) SERVING_PORT=$((p+13)) QA_PROJECT="langflow-qa-$slug-$p" && make qa-stack-seed EDITOR_BACKEND_PORT=$((p+10)) EDITOR_FRONTEND_PORT=$((p+11)) CP_PORT=$((p+12)) SERVING_PORT=$((p+13)) QA_PROJECT="langflow-qa-$slug-$p"

scripts.name: QA stack down
scripts.command: p=$((20000 + $(basename "$PWD" | cksum | cut -d' ' -f1) % 500 * 20)); slug=$(basename "$PWD" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | tr -c 'a-z0-9-\n' '-'); make qa-stack-down QA_PROJECT="langflow-qa-$slug-$p"
